export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never UV_NO_PROGRESS=1; for f in 'good' 'bad'; do ( cd "$f" && r=requirements.txt; [ -f $r ] || r=pyproject.toml; uv venv -q --python python3 "/daodan/state/venvs/$f" && uv pip install -q --python "/daodan/state/venvs/$f" -r "$r" ) > /tmp/daodan-restore.log 2>&1 || if [ -s /daodan/state/without-vcs.txt ]; then mv /tmp/daodan-restore.log /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; ( cd "$f" && r=requirements.txt; [ -f $r ] || r=pyproject.toml; uv pip install -q --python "/daodan/state/venvs/$f" -r "$r" --overrides /daodan/state/without-vcs.txt ) > /tmp/daodan-restore.log 2>&1 && { printf 'DAODAN-VCS-FAILED pip %s
' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|No solution|not found|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-VCS-END; } >&2 || { cat /tmp/daodan-restore.log >> /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; { printf 'DAODAN-RESTORE-FAILED pip %s
' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|No solution|not found|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log.vcs; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-RESTORE-END; } >&2; }; else { printf 'DAODAN-RESTORE-FAILED pip %s
' "$f"; { grep -E '^error|No solution|not found|^ *[×│├╰]|^ *Caused by' /tmp/daodan-restore.log || tail -n 30 /tmp/daodan-restore.log; } | head -n 30; echo DAODAN-RESTORE-END; } >&2; fi; done; true
